risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 22 days present binary risk for financials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical confluence (Hull flip, MACD crossover, three white soldiers, RSI(9) extreme) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) and contrarian congressional buying creates a classic capitulation entry setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 312.3, NFP volatility in 2 days, earnings binary risk in 22 days) combined with weak fundamental signals (zero insider activity, no smart money alignment), below-average volume support (0.77 ratio), and price below 200-EMA create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
